title: Projected D-delta-D third-coefficient scalar energy-moment candidate bridge
question: Can the registered finite-periodic local fifth energy moment supply a scalar energy-moment candidate for the P_sigma and Q_sigma inputs of EXP-001075, while isolating the noncommutative Q3 transfer obligation?

candidate_bridge.derivation: The scalar Holder/Jensen bounds give ||pM||_2<=m5^(1/4), ||M||_2<=m5^(3/20), and ||partial_q M||_2<=3m5^(1/10). scope.not_closed: This package closes only a scalar commuting energy-moment candidate and its exact rational fixture. It does not prove the actual Q3 mixed moments, noncommutative transfer, multiplication domination, modular domain, history, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, OS/KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

The powers m5^(1/4), m5^(3/20), and m5^(1/10) follow from Holder/Jensen on the declared scalar K moment; no extra moment is hidden.

Both plus and minus source orientations are retained through |p+/-a| and no parity equality is assumed.
The rational ceilings are generated by an exact denominator-120 search and independently checked by powered integer inequalities; they are not pasted derived constants.
m5=3 is a declared fixture input representing the registered finite-periodic compact-source scope, not a new thermodynamic theorem.
No estimate for delta(Y_sigma), Hamiltonian/modular commutation, or modular domain is inferred.
OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A and the TECT A1/R-192 production owner remain open.
